description: This file defines an interface 'SerializableComplexObsHandler' for handling complex observations within the OpenMRS platform. It declares methods for retrieving form fields associated with complex concept data and serializing form data, intended to be implemented by classes managing complex observation serialization.

classes.name: SerializableComplexObsHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling serialization of complex observations, responsible for generating form fields and serializing data for complex concepts.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Returns a set of form fields to be included in forms for complex concepts associated with this handler.

methods.name: serializeFormData
methods.description: Transforms and serializes the incoming form data, potentially converting formats for external communication like HL7 messages.
